title: unsetenv
summary: Remove an environment variable from the current RunMat process.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin. Numeric and provider-resident inputs are invalid environment-variable names and reject before provider or environment access.

description: Remove an environment variable from the current RunMat process.
behaviors: Accepts a string scalar or character row vector naming the environment variable.
Integer and other numeric inputs are not part of the API. Provider-resident numeric values reject before provider or environment access.
Runs on the host using the active RunMat filesystem, environment, or HTTP abstraction as appropriate.
Reports MATLAB-style runtime errors for unsupported argument shapes or unavailable host capabilities.
